title: AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-mome

translated_title: AF-Muon：一种面向权重绑定嵌入模型的无AdamW的Muon优化器
translated_abstract: Muon通过对方阵参数应用谱范数最速下降更新来改进大规模训练，但实际模型中还包含不符合稠密矩阵几何结构的参数块。一个重要的例子是权重绑定的词表，它出现在语言模型和其他token生成器中，可以接收多种结构不同的梯度来源，从稀疏的输入查表到稠密的输出分类器更新。在参考方案中，这些参数块被交给一个辅助的AdamW优化器处理，该优化器会恢复二阶矩状态并将这个共享别名的词表当作通用张量来更新。我们提出AF-Muon，这是Muon的一个无AdamW扩展：它对隐藏权重矩阵保留Muon的矩阵更新方式，同时对权重绑定的词表使用支持感知的有限容量线性最小化预言机，并对一维辅助参数使用RMS归一化更新。因此，AF-Muon能够用单一的…
tldr: 提出AF-Muon，一种完全摒弃AdamW的Muon优化器扩展，通过支持感知的有限容量线性最小化预言机处理权重绑定词表、用RMS归一化更新处理一维辅助参数，从而用单一优化器训练所有参数类别。
en_tdlr: AF-Muon extends Muon to be fully AdamW-free by applying a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle to tied vocabulary tables and RMS-normalized updates to one-dimensional parameters, enabling a single optimizer to train every parameter class in tied-embedding models.
